description: The accuracy trap measured directly. Scheme B (row-level) runs stratified K-fold over the duplicated rows, so copies of a signature straddle the fold boundary and the model is partly scored on memorised frames; encoding and scaling are fitted globally, as a naive pipeline would. Scheme A (signature-level) runs K-fold over unique signatures with light duplication applied inside each training fold only. Same models, folds and epochs; the difference is the inflation a leaky evaluation invents.

rowlevel_subsample.note: random subsample preserves the duplication structure; it caps runtime only. Scheme A uses all unique signatures.
